note: Town of Provost campground on the north side of the recreation park beside the ball diamonds; the Town advises booking early for baseball tournaments and the Kinsmen Splash and Smash weekend (Father's Day weekend). Shares a shower house with the Town's Kinsmen Campground on the south side of the park. --Claude
summary: Town page + Let's Camp read: 44 sites (not 53) with 30 A/water/sewer, up to 50 ft, C$40 a night tax included, showers/flush toilets/dump, booked on Let's Camp (was unrecorded). Note trimmed of field facts and the wrong 53/8-tent count.
flags: SITES: stored count 53 (derived from note prose: '45 full-hookup + 8 tent') is wrong; the Town page says 44 sites with power, water and sewer and Let's Camp lists 44 (40 RV, 4 tent, all 30 A full service). Written 44.

WEBSITE: https://provost.ca/things-to-do/campgrounds/ answered 200; booking https://letscamp.ca/camps/bannister-campground answered 200 - suggest adding it. Phone 780-753-2261 (Let's Camp and Google) matches stored. Google 3.8 from 8 reviews (under 25, no rating flag; local anyway).
SEASON: Let's Camp bio says 'Open seasonally from May through October' and its open dates for 2027 run May 13 - Oct 8; the Town page states no season. Stored approximate May-Oct (derived) left alone.

PIN (52.35399,-110.24931): lands on a residential lot just east of the campground. The pads (a treed island loop between the ball diamonds and the road) are centred about 85 m north-west at about 52.3545,-110.2503 (Let's Camp 52.35501,-110.25022, Google 52.35496,-110.25021). Under the 250 m threshold; optional move to 52.3545,-110.2503.

OTHER TOWN CAMPGROUNDS (not in the database; nearest entry is 15002 Home On The Range RV Park ~3 km south): the Town page also lists the Kinsmen Campground, '8 Power sites ... adjacent to the hall on the south side of the recreation park' (same park, under 1 km - not a split), and 'The Newest Campground is located next to the Museum and overlooking our scenic Trout Pond. With 20 sites, all built brand new in 2022, each has power and water.' The museum campground is a possible new lead (not vetted here).
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): no water beside the pads; the nearest water is a small channel/pond about 200 m east beyond the road and houses.
